name: make-cattain
title: A thread's agent makes a Cattain by asking
about: The person asks a thread for a Cattain for the iOS work. The fake CLI lists the Cattains and calls make_cattain through Neko's own MCP server. The thread shows the note "Made a Cattain: yuzu · iOS work" with Open, and the toast "Made yuzu" with Undo. The record has the tool's answer naming yuzu; RULES.md is seeded in yuzu's folder. Open takes the person to yuzu's own thread, which opens on who it is (its face and name, its purpose in the band). Settings ▸ Cattains lists yuzu, says the thread it was made in, and has "Agents may make Cattains".

steps.text: Make a Cattain for the iOS work [fake:mcp] mcp neko list_cattains {} ; mcp neko make_cattain {"purpose":"iOS work"}

see.label: Made a Cattain: yuzu · iOS work

steps.expect: The note in the thread and the toast with Undo

steps.name: made
steps.expect: The note between the steps and the agent's words; the toast above the composer

sh.run: test "$(grep -c 'Made a Cattain: yuzu (iOS work)' fake-record.jsonl)" -ge 1 && echo yes || echo no
test "$(grep -c '3 of at most 16 Cattains are at work' fake-record.jsonl)" -ge 1 && echo yes || echo no
test "$(grep -l 'Stay on your purpose (iOS work)' "$data"/cattains/*/RULES.md | wc -l)" -eq 1 && echo yes || echo no

steps.expect: The agent read the house, was told yuzu's name, and yuzu's RULES.md is in its folder
yuzu's own thread opens on who it is
Settings ▸ Cattains lists yuzu with the thread it was made in, and the switch
